name: @pithy-sh/monorepo

scripts.reset: turbo run reset && rm -rf node_modules && bun install

//: @cloudflare/workers-types is pinned below 5.20260807.2, which added `declare const Buffer: any`.
A block-scoped const cannot merge with @types/node's `var Buffer`, so the node:buffer global
augmentation is dropped and `randomBytes(8).toString('hex')` stops type-checking. It breaks any
tsconfig listing both @cloudflare/workers-types and node in `types` — packages/cli does.
5.20260804.1 is the last clean release, and is what this pins — verified by unpacking both tarballs.
Still unfixed as of 5.20260817.1. See #402 and docs/STACK.md §17.
REMOVE THIS PIN when a workers-types release declares Buffer as a `var`, or drops it: bump the
override to that version, run `bun run typecheck`, and if packages/cli is clean, delete this
block and the override with it. The declared ranges stay `^5.20260729.1` — adopters are not
affected, and a real scaffold was checked against 5.20260816.1 to confirm it.
